body.text: The Sail Fossil revives into Amaura, which evolves into Aurorus at level 39 during the nighttime.

sections.heading: Playthrough Notes
body: A Slow special attacker with broad coverage.
Aurorus offers strong special attacks and interesting Ice coverage, but its defensive typing gives it many weaknesses, including four-times weaknesses to Fighting and Steel.

Attack from favorable matchups and avoid leaving it in against physical Fighting, Steel, or Ground users. Refrigerate can turn Normal-type attacks into stronger Ice-type attacks. However it's limited learnset means it has a hard time making good use of this ability in most playthroughs.
More specialized than Tyrunt; valuable when the team specifically needs Ice and special damage.

sections.heading: Strengths and Weaknesses
body: Strengths: Good Special Attack and high HP. Ice is a stong attacking type. Refrigerate can turn Normal-type attacks into stronger Ice-type attacks. Can learn varied special coverage.
Weaknesses: Four-times weak to Fighting and Steel. Also weak to Water, Grass, Ground, and Rock. Slow. Rock has few special attacking moves.

sections.heading: Choice Context

body.text: Choose the Jaw Fossil for straightforward physical power. Choose the Sail Fossil for special Ice coverage.

body: Jaw Fossil is usually easier for a normal playthrough.

body.text: X/Y: Revive at Ambrette Fossil Lab in Ambrette Town. Revives at level 20.
Ultra Sun/Ultra Moon: Revive at Fossil Restoration Center in Route 8. Revives at level 15.
Legends: Z-A: Revive at Pokemon Research Lab 2F in Lumiose City. Revives at level 20.
